stepExplanation:
Electrical power can be calculated using three equivalent formulas:
- $$P = IV$$ (power = current × voltage)
- $$P = I^2R$$ (useful when current is known)
- $$P = \frac{V^2}{R}$$ (useful when voltage is known)
These are derived by combining P = IV with Ohm's law (V = IR).
stepBody: What formulas relate electrical power to voltage, current, and resistance?
